head: Watchmen maps surveillance cameras and license plate readers near you
dek: Watchmen shows public surveillance cameras on a map, including license plate readers, traffic and speed cameras. It was #20 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: You can see the ones around you or zoom out to see where they cluster in a city or country. It costs $4.99 with in-app purchases, by Fearless Design, and needs iOS 18.
means: You can see how many cameras watch the streets you use.
todo: Find Watchmen in the App Store.
